correctness.rationale: Verified classification reduction (Cao-Chen-Zhu: complete 3D shrinkers are quotients of S^3/R^3/S^2xR; noncompact leaves R^3 and S^2xR branches), f-preserving deck finiteness via O(3)/O(3)xZ_2 compactness (z-translations excluded as non-f-preserving), quotient shift nu(quot)=nu(cover)-log|G| with sign checked against RP^n and Gamma-invariance of the Yokota minimizer, exact values nu(R^3)=0 and nu_cyl(3)=log2-1, and competitor distances 0.30685/0.38629/0.69315 all >0.2 with margin >=0.106. Reproduced artifacts/entropy_gaps.py at 80-digit precision: ALL CHECKS PASSED. Inventory lists all finite-order values including some non-free orbifold orders, a harmless over-approximation since actual manifold values form a subset and the minimum distance is attained at R^3 itself.

All twenty terminal candidates were excluded on body-level evidence (full-text parameter search, theorem scope, or section inspection), including both dissertations, the Perelman founding paper, the volume-growth survey, the 4D gap paper, the OUP Wasserstein paper via its identical arXiv version, and the BJGA, AMS-gap, and Cao-slides PDFs via archived copies. value.rationale: EMERGENT_FINDING is the exact n=3 restriction of the admitted high-risk target with explicit constant eps_3=0.2, derived through target work after documented general-n blockers. It is a proved structural rigidity theorem plus reusable finite-quotient entropy inventory, motivated before computation, not known or mechanically implied, with the object and invariant fixed by the target. A future researcher asking the 3D cylinder entropy-gap question can directly retrieve and use the precise constant and proof; non-extension to n>=4 is honestly documented.
